cond_0001.intro: The Quality Assurance Specialist provides technical support to manufacturing, support areas, stakeholders, and clients on quality matters, while complying with safety, quality, and process improvement standards. Actively participates in strategies that assure quality in the process and finished product.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Leads investigations with manufacturing areas to ensure finished products reach the customer in accordance with current specifications.
Leads and participates in root cause analysis, performing activities to validate corrective actions and eliminate quality losses in the process.
Supports and generates synergy with other areas to comply with the Quality Management System through correct implementation, execution, maintenance, and improvement throughout the supply chain.
Management and leadership of product investigations for deviations in physicochemical, sensory, and GC parameters.
Follow-up of NCs (Z1 (customer), Z3(MQI), Z4(RM), Z5(IPQI)): closing of actions and follow-up to each responsible party.
Review and follow-up of internal NCs closure and determination of confirmed error and respective area.
Review and follow-up of recoveries and reworks of raw materials and finished product.
Review and follow-up of tests (impact tests, small manufacturing tests, review of second GC samples).
Follow-up and recovery of materials impacting provision.
Preparation and dissemination of weekly quality communication to shopfloor.
[Product name masked] Quality modules housekeeping.
ELEVATE Project key team member for Quality (SAP Implementation).
ISO9001 Implementation key lead member for Quality.
Maintain safe behavior and respect procedures and rules of Quality, Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental protection at all times.
Report incidents, accidents, conditions, or acts that put at risk the integrity of people, product safety, or environmental impact according to the Quality Management System and organizational guidelines.
Abide by rules established in governmental laws, internal regulations, policies, procedures, memos, notices, and operation manuals, as well as orders from authorized superiors.
Keep updated all documents or records assigned to this position in the document management system.
Actively participate in root-cause analysis derived from any deviation, process results, indicators, audit, or investigation, as part of corrective or preventive actions toward the integral management system.
Participate in internal deviation investigations.
Monitor processes on the manufacturing floor.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a related field.
Experience in manufacturing companies in a similar role or related to quality control.
Bilingual (English and Spanish).
Knowledge of ISO9001, Chromatography, Root Cause Analysis Methodologies, and Office skills.

SAP and Statistical Process Control knowledge.

The Quality Assurance Specialist provides technical support to manufacturing, support areas, stakeholders, and clients on quality matters, while complying with safety, quality, and process improvement standards. A regular part of the role is staying in contact with manufacturing areas and other teams to ensure finished products reach the customer in accordance with current specifications.
Actively contribute to strategies that assure quality in the process and finished product.
Lead investigations in conjunction with manufacturing areas, regularly communicating with teams to ensure finished products meet current specifications.
Lead and participate in root cause analysis, working closely with relevant areas to validate corrective actions and eliminate quality losses.
Connect with other areas to support and generate synergy for the Quality Management System through correct implementation, execution, maintenance, and improvement across the supply chain.
Lead product investigations for deviations in physicochemical, sensory, and GC parameters, explaining findings and walking stakeholders through decisions.
Follow up on NCs (Z1 (customer), Z3(MQI), Z4(RM), Z5(IPQI)): closing of actions and follow-up with each responsible party.
Review and follow up on internal NC closures and determination of ""confirmed error"" and respective area.
Review and follow up on recoveries and reworks of raw materials and finished product.
Review and follow up on tests (impact tests, small manufacturing tests, second GC samples).
Follow up on and recover materials impacting provision.
Prepare and disseminate weekly quality communication to the shopfloor.
[Product name masked] Quality modules housekeeping.
Key team member for Quality on the ELEVATE Project (SAP Implementation).
Key lead member for Quality on ISO9001 Implementation.
Maintain safe behavior and respect procedures and rules of Quality, Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental protection at all times.
Report incidents, accidents, conditions, or acts that put at risk the integrity of people, product safety, or environmental impact according to the Quality Management System and organizational guidelines.
Abide by rules established in governmental laws, internal regulations, policies, procedures, memos, notices, and operation manuals, as well as instructions from authorized superiors.
Keep documents and records under this position updated in the document management system.
Actively participate in root cause analysis derived from any deviation, process results, indicators, audit, or investigation, contributing to corrective or preventive actions for the integral management system.
Participate in internal deviation investigations.
Monitor processes on the manufacturing floor.
cond_0231.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a related field.
Knowledge of ISO9001, SAP, Chromatography, Statistical Process Control, Root Cause Analysis Methodologies, and Office tools.
Bilingual (English and Spanish).
Experience in manufacturing companies in a similar role or related to quality control.
SAP Statistical Process Control experience.

cond_0271.intro: The Quality Assurance Specialist provides technical support to manufacturing, support areas, stakeholders, and clients on quality matters, while complying with safety, quality, and process improvement standards. Actively participates in strategies that assure quality in the process and finished product.
cond_0271.responsibilities:
Leads investigations with manufacturing areas to ensure finished products reach the customer in accordance with current specifications.
Leads and participates in root cause analysis, performing activities to validate corrective actions and eliminate quality losses in the process.
Supports and generates synergy with other areas to comply with the Quality Management System through correct implementation, execution, maintenance, and improvement throughout the supply chain.
Management and leadership of product investigations for deviations in physicochemical, sensory, and GC parameters.
Follow-up of NCs (Z1 (customer), Z3(MQI), Z4(RM), Z5(IPQI)): closing of actions and follow-up to each responsible party.
Review and follow-up of internal NCs closure and determination of confirmed error and respective area.
Review and follow-up of recoveries and reworks of raw materials and finished product.
Review and follow-up of tests (impact tests, small manufacturing tests, review of second GC samples).
Follow-up and recovery of materials impacting provision.
Preparation and dissemination of weekly quality communication to shopfloor.
[Product name masked] Quality modules housekeeping.
ELEVATE Project key team member for Quality (SAP Implementation).
ISO9001 Implementation key lead member for Quality.
Maintain safe behavior and respect procedures and rules of Quality, Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental protection at all times.
Report incidents, accidents, conditions, or acts that put at risk the integrity of people, product safety, or environmental impact according to the Quality Management System and organizational guidelines.
Abide by rules established in governmental laws, internal regulations, policies, procedures, memos, notices, and operation manuals, as well as orders from authorized superiors.
Keep updated all documents or records assigned to this position in the document management system.
Actively participate in root-cause analysis derived from any deviation, process results, indicators, audit, or investigation, as part of corrective or preventive actions toward the integral management system.
Participate in internal deviation investigations.
Monitor processes on the manufacturing floor.
